title: Semiparametric Inference in Panel Data with Interactive and High-dimensional Confounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.14385v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops inference for a low-dimensional treatment coefficient in partially linear panel models with high-dimensional observed covariates and latent interactive confounding. Flexible adjustment for observed covariates can leave correlated factor components in treatment and outcome residuals, invalidating standard double/debiased machine learning (DML). We propose Factor-Augmented DML (FA-DML), which estimates treatment-side and reduced-form factor spaces from first-stage residuals. The estimator combines a feasible double projection with three-fold, unit-level cross-fitting. The double projection controls interactions between the two estimated factor spaces. The separate folds eliminate same-training-unit pairings in the leading disturbance components of the factor-estimation errors. translated_title: 具有交互式与高维混淆因素的面板数据中的半参数推断
translated_abstract: 本文针对含有高维观测协变量和潜在交互混淆因素的部分线性面板模型，发展了针对低维处理系数的推断方法。对观测协变量进行灵活调整后，处理残差和结果残差中仍可能残留相关的因子成分，从而使标准的双重/去偏机器学习方法（DML）失效。我们提出了因子增广DML（FA-DML），该方法从第一阶段残差中估计处理端和简化式的因子空间。该估计量将可行的双重投影与三折、单元级交叉拟合相结合。双重投影用于控制两个被估因子空间之间的交互作用；而相互独立的折数则消除了因子估计误差主要扰动成分中来自同一训练单元的配对。在因子秩固定、因子信号普遍存在、严格外生性以及单元数 N 与时期数 T 的联合渐近条件下，FA-DML 是……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出因子增广双重/去偏机器学习方法（FA-DML），通过双重投影与单元级三折交叉拟合，在高维协变量与潜在交互混淆因素并存的面板数据中实现了对低维处理系数的有效统计推断。
en_tdlr: Proposes Factor-Augmented DML (FA-DML), combining a feasible double projection with unit-level three-fold cross-fitting to achieve valid inference for treatment effects in partially linear panel models with high-dimensional covariates and latent interactive confounding.
